docs.title: MedicalNote
docs.text: A entidade MedicalNote existe no Dominio e esta configurada no EF Core, mas nao tem endpoint, comando ou request associado. đựe ser um recurso incompleto ou reservado para uso interno/futuro.

docs.title: Composition Root
docs.text:
ClinicalProntuaryModule implementa IModule (SharedKernel) e e descoberto automaticamente por reflexao pelo ModuleScanner. Regista:

  • Application: MediatR sobre o assembly marcado por ClinicalProntuaryApplicationMarker
  • Infrastructure: DbContext (Npgsql), repositorios
  • Endpoints: Prontuaries, Visits, ClinicalRecords

docs.title: Persistencia
docs.text:
• DbContext: ClinicalProntuaryDbContext estende SatDbContext (building block que combina DbContext + IUnitOfWork), schema PostgreSQL clinical_prontuary
  • DbSets: Prontuaries, Visits, Diagnoses, Prescriptions, LabResults, AllergyRecords, ImmunizationRecords, MedicalNotes
  • Unit of Work: EfUnitOfWork implementa IClinicalProntuaryUnitOfWork (extensao de Sat.Persistence.UnitOfWork.IUnitOfWork)
  • Repositorios: IProntuaryRepository : IRepository<Prontuary, Guid> (SharedKernel) e ProntuaryRepository : BaseRepository<Prontuary, Guid, ClinicalProntuaryDbContext> (Persistence) — herda GetByIdAsync, AddAsync e Remove do building block

docs.title: Aplicar migracoes
docs.text:
dotnet ef database update \
  --project modules/ClinicalProntuary/Infrastructure \
  --startup-project src/Sat.Api \
  --context ClinicalProntuaryDbContext

docs.title: Prontuario idempotente
docs.text: O CreateProntuaryCommand e idempotente: se ja existir prontuario para o PatientId, retorna o existente em vez de falhar.

docs.title: Medicacoes ativas
docs.text: GetActiveMedications() filtra prescricoes por data: inclui prescricoes onde StartDate <= agora e EndDate e null ou >= agora.

docs.title: Resultados laboratoriais
docs.text: LabResult.ResultData e armazenado como JSON PostgreSQL (jsonb). O formato e livre — a aplicacao deve garantir consistencia.

docs.title: FHIR
docs.text: O endpoint /fhir e um wrapper simplificado que combina FindProntuaryByPatientIdQuery e GetPatientClinicalSummaryQuery num formato inspirado em FHIR Bundle. Nao e uma implementacao FHIR completa.

}

docs.text: Todos os endpoints usam politicas manuais via ProntuaryPolicies: - Leitura: roles SYSTEM_ADMIN, ORG_ADMIN, SERVICE_ACCOUNT, CLINICAL_ACTOR, VIEW_PATIENT_HISTORY, ou CUSTOM com 2FA - Escrita: requer 2FA + roles SYSTEM_ADMIN, ORG_ADMIN, SERVICE_ACCOUNT, CLINICAL_ACTOR, PRESCRIBER, DIAGNOSER

docs.title: Casos de Uso de Prontuarios
docs.text:
homepage Modulo ClinicalProntuary · Visao Geral

Grupo de rotas: /prontuaries · Requer autenticacao.

docs.title: 1.1 Criar prontuario
docs.text:
• Caso de uso: CreateProntuaryCommand
  • Endpoint: POST /api/v1/clinical-prontuary/prontuaries
  • Finalidade: criar um prontuario para um paciente
  • Modelo principal: Prontuary

docs.title: Body
docs.text:
{
  "patientId": "patient-123",
  "bloodType": "O+"
}

patientId e obrigatorio. bloodType e opcional.

docs.title: Regras de negocio
docs.text:
• patientId e obrigatorio (ClinicalProntuary.PatientIdRequired)
  • se ja existir prontuario para o paciente, retorna o existente sem criar duplicado (ClinicalProntuary.AlreadyExists)

docs.title: Exemplo de chamada
docs.text:
curl -X POST http://localhost:5000/api/v1/clinical-prontuary/prontuaries \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <jwt>' \
  -d '{
    "patientId": "patient-123",
    "bloodType": "O+"
  }'

docs.title: Sucesso esperado
docs.text:
• 201 Created
  • retorno: Prontuary
{
  "id": "f1ac3c5e-6fd2-4a7a-b64e-72f40be690cf",
  "patientId": "patient-123",
  "bloodType": "O+",
  "createdAt": "2026-08-18T12:00:00Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-08-18T12:00:00Z"
}

docs.title: Erros esperados
docs.text: HTTP Code Situacao 400 ClinicalProntuary.PatientIdRequired patientId vazio

docs.title: 1.2 Obter prontuario por paciente
docs.text:
• Caso de uso: FindProntuaryByPatientIdQuery
  • Endpoint: GET /api/v1/clinical-prontuary/prontuaries/{patientId}
  • Finalidade: obter o prontuario completo com todas as consultas, alergias e imunizacoes

docs.title: Sucesso esperado
docs.text:
• 200 OK
  • retorno: Prontuary (com colecoes)

docs.title: Erros esperados
docs.text: HTTP Code Situacao 404 ClinicalProntuary.NotFound prontuario inexistente

docs.title: 1.3 Obter resumo clinico (FHIR)
docs.text:
• Caso de uso: FindProntuaryByPatientIdQuery + GetPatientClinicalSummaryQuery
  • Endpoint: GET /api/v1/clinical-prontuary/prontuaries/{patientId}/fhir
  • Finalidade: bundle FHIR com prontuario e resumo clinico

docs.title: Sucesso esperado
docs.text:
• 200 OK
{
  "resourceType": "Bundle",
  "type": "collection",
  "patient": { ... },
  "summary": {
    "prontuary": { ... },
    "visits": [ ... ],
    "diagnoses": [ ... ],
    "prescriptions": [ ... ],
    "labResults": [ ... ],
    "allergies": [ ... ],
    "immunizations": [ ... ]
  }
}

docs.title: Erros esperados
docs.text: HTTP Code Situacao 404 ClinicalProntuary.NotFound prontuario inexistente

docs.title: Casos de Uso de Consultas
docs.text:
homepage Modulo ClinicalProntuary · Visao Geral

Grupo de rotas: /prontuaries/{patientId}/visits · Requer autenticacao.

docs.title: 2.1 Criar consulta
docs.text:
• Caso de uso: CreateVisitCommand
  • Endpoint: POST /api/v1/clinical-prontuary/prontuaries/{patientId}/visits
  • Finalidade: registar uma nova consulta num prontuario
  • Modelo principal: Visit

docs.title: Body
docs.text:
{
  "clinicalItemId": "clinical-item-uuid",
  "hospitalId": "hospital-uuid",
  "doctorId": "doctor-uuid",
  "date": "2026-08-18T10:30:00Z",
  "type": "Consultation",
  "notes": "Consulta de rotina"
}

Todos os campos exceto notes sao obrigatorios.

docs.title: Regras de negocio
docs.text: • o prontuario do paciente tem de existir (ClinicalProntuary.ProntuaryNotFound)

docs.title: Sucesso esperado
docs.text:
• 201 Created
  • retorno: Visit

docs.title: Erros esperados
docs.text: HTTP Code Situacao 404 ClinicalProntuary.ProntuaryNotFound prontuario inexistente para o paciente

docs.title: 2.2 Listar consultas do paciente
docs.text:
• Caso de uso: GetVisitsByPatientQuery
  • Endpoint: GET /api/v1/clinical-prontuary/prontuaries/{patientId}/visits
  • Finalidade: obter todas as consultas de um paciente

docs.title: Sucesso esperado
docs.text:
• 200 OK
  • retorno: array de Visit
